change: Native named sender deposit uses exactly two root actions and explicitly authorized sender RAM. Remove execution/minimum/relay/application RAM payment on native deposit; no AIC fee funding or automatic RAM purchase. Insufficient sender RAM rejects atomically.

native_deposit.atomicity: Pending lock is installed before sender-funded allocation/credit. Only exact actual principal notification can settle; all spending/reentrant paths are locked and any failure rolls back native funds, rows and RAM.
native_deposit.custody_admission: Existing audited-token admission remains separate; shared non-AIC custody RAM must already be registered, no silent global token setup or RAM purchases charged to native sender. CurrentAIC/USD/CNY are admitted.
native_deposit.fees: All fee receipt amounts and contract-funded RAM byte fields are zero; actual sender RAM is native billing, not metered by fee receipt.
native_deposit.legacy_native_packets: Old three-root paid deposit rejected; clients must use new two-root mode. User explicitly requests contract-first rollout, wallet directly adopts new mode without extra activation gate.
native_deposit.lifetime: Rows retain their original native RAM payer until a future explicitly reviewed lifecycle change; RAM payer has no asset control.
native_deposit.ram_payer: Explicit named sender for newly created wallet, secondary index and balance rows; original payers preserved for existing rows. Fixed-size global growth state retains its original payer.
